import sys

class CF884F:
    A = 26
    INF = 10**9

    def __init__(self):
        self.oo = None
        self.oh = None
        self.__ = 1
        self.ii = None
        self.jj = None
        self.cc = None
        self.cost = None
        self.cost_ = None
        self.m_ = 0
        self.ae = None
        self.pi = None
        self.dd = None
        self.ff = None
        self.n_ = 0
        self.pq = None
        self.iq = None
        self.cnt = 0

    def link(self, o, h):
        self.oo[self.__] = o
        self.oh[self.__] = h
        self.__ += 1
        return self.__ - 1

    def init(self):
        self.oo = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.oh = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.ii = [0] * self.m_
        self.jj = [0] * self.m_
        self.cc = [0] * (self.m_ << 1)
        self.cost = [0] * self.m_
        self.cost_ = [0] * self.m_
        self.pi = [0] * self.n_
        self.dd = [0] * self.n_
        self.ff = [0] * self.n_
        self.ae = [0] * self.n_
        self.pq = [0] * (1 + self.n_)
        self.iq = [0] * self.n_
        self.m_ = 0

    def link_(self, i, j, c, co):
        h = self.m_
        self.m_ += 1
        self.ii[h] = i
        self.jj[h] = j
        self.cc[h << 1] = c
        self.cost[h] = co
        self.ae[i] = self.link(self.ae[i], h << 1)
        self.ae[j] = self.link(self.ae[j], h << 1 | 1)

    def less(self, u, v):
        return self.pi[u] < self.pi[v] or (self.pi[u] == self.pi[v] and self.dd[u] < self.dd[v])

    def i2(self, i):
        i *= 2
        if i > self.cnt:
            return 0
        if i < self.cnt and self.less(self.pq[i + 1], self.pq[i]):
            return i + 1
        return i

    def pq_up(self, u):
        i = self.iq[u]
        while i > 1:
            j = i // 2
            v = self.pq[j]
            if not self.less(u, v):
                break
            self.pq[i] = v
            self.iq[v] = i
            i = j
        self.pq[i] = u
        self.iq[u] = i

    def pq_dn(self, u):
        i = self.iq[u]
        while True:
            j = self.i2(i)
            if j == 0:
                break
            v = self.pq[j]
            if not self.less(v, u):
                break
            self.pq[i] = v
            self.iq[v] = i
            i = j
        self.pq[i] = u
        self.iq[u] = i

    def pq_add_last(self, u):
        self.cnt += 1
        self.pq[self.cnt] = u
        self.iq[u] = self.cnt

    def pq_remove_first(self):
        u = self.pq[1]
        v = self.pq[self.cnt]
        self.cnt -= 1
        if v != u:
            self.iq[v] = 1
            self.pq_dn(v)
        self.iq[u] = 0
        return u

    def dijkstra(self, s, t):
        self.pi = [self.INF] * self.n_
        self.pi[s] = 0
        self.pq_add_last(s)
        while self.cnt > 0:
            i = self.pq_remove_first()
            d = self.dd[i] + 1
            o = self.ae[i]
            while o != 0:
                h_ = self.oh[o]
                if self.cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    j = i ^ self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]
                    p = self.pi[i] + (self.cost_[h] if (h_ & 1) == 0 else -self.cost_[h])
                    if self.pi[j] > p or (self.pi[j] == p and self.dd[j] > d):
                        if self.pi[j] == self.INF:
                            self.pq_add_last(j)
                        self.pi[j] = p
                        self.dd[j] = d
                        self.ff[j] = h_
                        self.pq_up(j)
                o = self.oo[o]
        return self.pi[t] != self.INF

    def trace(self, s, t):
        while t != s:
            h_ = self.ff[t]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= 1
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            t ^= self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]
        return 1

    def edmonds_karp(self, s, t):
        # initial potentials (Bellman-Ford not needed, all edges from source have cost 0)
        # but we set pi to 0 initially
        self.pi = [0] * self.n_
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.pi[j] = min(self.pi[j], self.pi[i] + self.cost[h])
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.cost_[h] = self.cost[h] + self.pi[i] - self.pi[j]
        f = 0
        while self.dijkstra(s, t):
            f += self.trace(s, t)
            for h in range(self.m_):
                i = self.ii[h]
                j = self.jj[h]
                if self.pi[i] != self.INF and self.pi[j] != self.INF:
                    self.cost_[h] += self.pi[i] - self.pi[j]
        ans = 0
        for h in range(self.m_):
            ans += self.cc[h << 1 | 1] * self.cost[h]
        return ans

    def main(self):
        data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        it = iter(data)
        n = int(next(it)) // 2
        self.n_ = 1 + n + self.A + 1
        self.m_ = n + n * self.A + self.A
        self.init()
        s = next(it).strip()
        cc = [ord(c) - 97 for c in s]  # 'a' -> 0
        bb = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n * 2)]
        for i in range(n):
            self.link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0)
        for i in range(n):
            j = n * 2 - 1 - i
            ai = cc[i]
            aj = cc[j]
            for a in range(self.A):
                if a == ai and a == aj:
                    b = max(bb[i], bb[j])
                elif a == ai:
                    b = bb[i]
                elif a == aj:
                    b = bb[j]
                else:
                    b = 0
                self.link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b)
        kk = [0] * self.A
        for i in range(n * 2):
            a = cc[i]
            kk[a] += 1
        for a in range(self.A):
            self.link_(1 + n + a, self.n_ - 1, kk[a], 0)
        ans = -self.edmonds_karp(0, self.n_ - 1)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    CF884F().main()
